## Data classification

- [ ] SYNTHETIC illustration (must be labeled synthetic in every artifact)
- [ ] Public-source-derived research reference (not proposed for on-chain seeding)

## Source and date

Link public sources only. Do not attach private records or copied personal content.

## Proposed lesson for testing or documentation

## Privacy and harm review

Confirm that the proposal contains no private individual's name, contact details, account identifiers, private conversation, or non-public evidence. Never propose a real incident as demo seed data.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have permission to share any included material.
- [ ] No raw claim, defense, inline evidence, or personal information is included.
- [ ] The synthetic status and source will remain visible wherever this data appears.
